limitations: A bounded pilot, not a proof that no better source/context basin exists.
Initial source operators reused on every context without requiring starts to improve current source.
Raw target score excludes sibling penalty; sibling greens checked separately.
First phase has monotone/plateau exploration only. Seed1307 restarts from the best reached so far, including seed8447. Escape phase is separate.
Masked raw hashes are not evidence of normalized machine-code movement until replayed.
Second pass allowed uphill+4, but zero uphill moves were accepted in its sampled proposals. This is not evidence that wider or deeper escape cannot work.
Raw payload hash claims use mask-zero comparisons; masked cases had no raw-hash-change witnesses and no score interactions, but are not a full normalized-hash equivalence proof.
Initial and adaptive operators can produce non-equivalent or invalid C; no source partial was applied.
Saved best object may be an equally scored completion-order tie; each actual object was checked against a recorded candidate and locally rescored.
Whole-TU green status checked independently; starts were never rejected for being worse than current source.
interpretation: This bounded pilot did not find a better source/context combination. It does not establish absence of another basin. The nominal uphill pass selected the minimum acceptable proposal and accepted no cost-increasing moves; it therefore did not demonstrate escape requiring an uphill path. Unknown relocation masks are excluded from raw hash equivalence claims. No partial source changes were retained.
